tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark is Territorial's Deep Black; light is True White. Replaces zinc-950.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, table header bands, the status banner in its neutral state.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, dialogs, tags, unselected segments, inputs.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, ghost buttons and nav links. Territorial's Slate Overlay.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a dialog.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control. Dark is Territorial's Graphite Gray.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox and secondary-button outlines; 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and test names on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, values in tables, nav links at rest; on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Labels, column headers, timestamps, hints; on bg, surface and surface-raised. Replaces zinc-500 and zinc-600 text, which failed 4.5:1.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and of the selected segment or filter.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Territorial's Emerald. The logo's signal, the focus ring and the active nav underline. Never a button fill or link colour: emerald also means Operational.

tokens.name: operational
tokens.usage: The word Operational, Recovered text and uptime figures at 100%; on bg, surface, surface-raised and operational-tint.

tokens.name: operational-solid
tokens.usage: Operational marks: status dot, history cells.

tokens.name: operational-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an Operational chip or banner.

tokens.name: degraded
tokens.usage: The word Degraded and warning text; on bg, surface, surface-raised and degraded-tint.

tokens.name: degraded-solid
tokens.usage: Degraded marks: status triangle, history cells with mixed results.

tokens.name: degraded-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a Degraded chip, banner or warning callout.

tokens.name: outage
tokens.usage: The word Outage, error text and destructive actions; on bg, surface, surface-raised and outage-tint.

tokens.name: outage-solid
tokens.usage: Outage marks: status square, history cells where every run failed.

tokens.name: outage-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an Outage chip, banner or error callout.

tokens.name: unknown-solid
tokens.usage: Marks for No data and Paused. The word itself is set in fg-subtle.

tokens.name: strip-empty
tokens.usage: History cells with no runs, and loading skeletons.

families.mono: Inconsolata, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The uptime figure on a status card or public test page. One per card.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The h1 of every page: a test name, an incident title, a page name.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name beside the mark. Always lowercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Banner headline, dialog title, card title on the public list view.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Default interface text: table cells, nav, buttons, inputs, values.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Tags, chips, secondary lines in a row, timestamps.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings on dashboard and status page. Uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, definition terms. Uppercase. The smallest size in the system; nothing is set at 10px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Test code, error messages, token and secret names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A radar run stalled after the cluster API dropped for a few seconds.
styles.usage: Incident reports and updates, descriptions, empty states, dialog copy. Lines at most 68 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Field hints, section descriptions, callout text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; between a status mark and its word (with space-2).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small buttons; gap between controls in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; status card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field stack gap; card padding on the public list view; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; gap between nav links; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a page.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: History strip cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, chips, segments. The system is square by default.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, popovers, dialogs, banners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The Operational dot and the switch only.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and dialogs only. Cards are flat.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width of every page, centred.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of settings pages and forms.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of incident report text.
